Flatiron ZIP printed as 100117 on page (10011 + '7th floor' run together) - ZIP 10011. Flatiron is upstairs/by appointment - flag if appointment showrooms are excluded.

craft_evidence.owned: claimed and placed — 'PatBO's atelier' in Uberlândia, Brazil, alongside an embroidery school founded by Bonaldi; no address or photograph on the page read
craft_evidence.makers: no individual makers; the atelier and 'talented artisans in her hometown of Uberlândia' are named as a place
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed — founded 2002; designer's couture label in São Paulo; Uberlândia atelier; Projeto Costurando Sonhos 2015
craft_evidence.process: partial — hand embroidery and beading named on PDPs (one top 'takes two days to make'); embroidery school documented
craft_evidence.reasoning: Most product pages say Made in Brazil, and the about page places the making in the brand's own atelier and embroidery school in Uberlândia, with hand embroidery described on product pages. The atelier is claimed rather than shown and no mills are named, so it's a 3; documented ownership of the Uberlândia atelier would argue for 4.
